status: Consolidated available-evidence and operational requirements for the final proposed design; full source and customer-decision closure remain incomplete.

requirements.title: Customer identity and roles
requirements.requirement: Keep account owner, buyer, proposer, payer, nominee and intended insured distinct; relationships are directional and dated. Never derive birth date from age alone.

requirements.title: Facts and corrections
requirements.requirement: Retain assertions by subject, predicate, units, source, valid time, recorded time, uncertainty and supersession. A proposal or model interpretation is not an accepted fact.

requirements.title: Priorities and resources
requirements.requirement: Keep hard constraints, preferences, available cash, premium budget and ongoing expenditure separately; compare like-for-like periods and configurations.

requirements.title: Product identities and configurations
requirements.requirement: Identify insurer, family, variant and selectable options separately from marketing labels and accepted configurations; record scope exclusions without guessing identity.

requirements.title: Terms applicability over time
requirements.requirement: Retain UIN separately from terms revision, source hash, issue/renewal/treatment trigger, supersession and regulatory modification; same UIN can contain changed terms.

requirements.title: Individual acceptance and membership
requirements.requirement: Proposed, offered, accepted and in-force configurations differ. Bind each person, option, personal exclusion, loading and co-pay to its issued evidence and interval.

requirements.title: Evidence and connected context
requirements.requirement: Preserve original bytes, URL provenance, acquisition failures, physical pages, printed labels, paragraph/table/figure coordinates, footnotes and linked clauses. Document presence does not prove full rule coverage.

requirements.title: Rules, exceptions and conflicts
requirements.requirement: Represent grants, definitions, restrictions, exclusions, exceptions and mandatory dependencies with explicit scope. Conflicting originals block affected claims until evidenced resolution; legal portfolio duties are not product promises.

requirements.title: Medical disclosures and clocks
requirements.requirement: Separate diagnoses, advice, symptoms, medicines and findings, their dates and subjects; preserve proposal question scope independently of PED lookback and prospective waits.

requirements.title: Existing-cover periods and continuity
requirements.requirement: Compare current policy terms, effective revisions, selected cover and verified person-specific continuity credits with a proposed purchase. Do not maintain claim-usage or annual payment ledgers.

requirements.title: Renewal, instalment and cancellation terms
requirements.requirement: Structure the public renewal, grace, instalment, free-look, cancellation and portability rules needed to compare products, plus customer-reported current policy dates when relevant. Do not administer requests, receipts, payments, cancellation or refunds.

requirements.title: Typed quantities and comparisons
requirements.requirement: Distinguish zero, unlimited, unknown and not-applicable. Carry currency, percentage denominator, quantity dimensions, calendar units, comparison operator and rounding evidence.

requirements.title: Expense admissibility and cost shares
requirements.requirement: Evaluate each expense, event, provider and treatment setting, room ratio, sublimit, inclusive components, deductible and co-pay in the evidenced order. Record alternative orders when unresolved.

requirements.title: Scope, accumulation and limits
requirements.requirement: Scope balances by member/family/illness/claim/admission/body part/year; separate payable amounts, threshold accumulation, sum-insured consumption, reserves and already paid amounts.

requirements.title: Dependent tables and restoration
requirements.requirement: Store selector semantics and complete row/column/footnote evidence; apply bonus, recharge and restored sublimit constraints separately from headline cover.

requirements.title: Owned dated quotes
requirements.requirement: Bind private quotes, premium components, tax evidence, payment schedules, offer validity and acceptance to owner, people, facts and exact options. Corrected facts invalidate comparisons.

requirements.title: Provider observations
requirements.requirement: Identify legal provider and branch independently of names; date and scope network, restricted network and exclusions by insurer/product/service; authorization decisions are separate.

requirements.title: Deterministic mandatory retrieval
requirements.requirement: Filter owner and accepted fact/configuration/time snapshots before loading all mandatory rules, linked definitions, exceptions and unresolved dependencies; semantic ranking cannot omit mandatory rules.

requirements.title: Saved claims and replay
requirements.requirement: Persist supported answer claims, their exact evidence and assumptions, calculation trace, source/customer/observation revisions, scope, outcome and unresolved dependencies; preserve historical answers while invalidating current ones.

requirements.title: Ownership, privacy and deletion
requirements.requirement: Enforce account isolation for every private row and original; preserve password/session continuity during migration. Delete content and dependent indexes/caches with explicit retention holds, without retaining erased values in audit logs.

requirements.title: Concurrent durable turns
requirements.requirement: Persist idempotent submissions and outbox before dispatch; optimistic fact revisions, worker leases, cancellation, durable event cursors and explicit retry attempts prevent duplicate inference and stale publication.

requirements.title: Processing and publication
requirements.requirement: Track reader/extractor/reviewer versions, failures, attempts, dependency closure, coverage denominators and atomic corpus publication; initial plus two targeted retries do not turn unresolved omissions into published knowledge.

requirements.title: Model qualification and telemetry
requirements.requirement: Persist exact relay/model/schema identity, qualification evidence, provider attempts, usage, latency and operational failures; no silent model fallback. Separate inference from durable user-visible state.

requirements.title: Independent acceptance
requirements.requirement: Keep benchmark questions/solutions in a separate access-controlled store and expose only generalized requirements and aggregate results; track exposure, replacement lineage, freeze and three attempts without changing denominators.

requirements.title: Reversible migration and engineering
requirements.requirement: Preserve pilot UUIDs, auth hashes, ownership, messages and original bytes; quarantine unsafe semantic mappings, rehearse rollback and verify performance and robustness before cutover.

requirements.title: Claim events, necessary documents and actual payments
requirements.requirement: Keep submission, recipient receipt, document requests, accepted original/copy form, completeness, the last necessary-document receipt and actual payment separate by claim. Preserve event corrections, disputed necessity, sender/recipient authority and exact source evidence. Deadline, delayed-interest and payment results must retain their actual anchors, dated external rate and unresolved day-count/rounding authority. Mandatory hospitalization notices can exist before a claim.
requirements.evaluation_basis: No benchmark material read; source-derived requirement. Existing reference examples touch payments/access but do not certify coverage of the new last-document interest pattern.

requirements.title: Immutable independent inventory and coverage accounting
requirements.requirement: Retain candidate original occurrences separately from adjudicated atomic denominator membership. Seal exact counting protocols, source scope, per-revision members and split/merge/qualifier lineage. Link each historical coverage report to its exact sealed revision and immutable supported-member reviews, counting each included instance once. Unknown segmentation or governing-original closure keeps the denominator unmeasured; parser output cannot establish its own denominator.
basis: user plan independent original inventory and historical acceptance accounting
requirements.evaluation_basis: No benchmark solutions or cases are stored in this operational inventory; evaluation remains a separate controlled workflow.

requirements.title: Public packaged/combi products
requirements.requirement: Keep the public wrapper edition, component products and component versions separate, including required, optional or conditional selection rules and supported coupled consequences. Existing customer cover remains separate policies and sourced facts; package servicing is outside scope.
requirements.evaluation_basis: No private evaluation solution used; supplementary original-derived reference case.

current_source_assessment: Cumulative r22: all 203 legacy identities retained; 181 selected-insurer rows have bounded wording candidates; zero exact historical bundles complete. Manual scope review covers 352 PDFs and 16 non-PDF originals across all 20 insurers. The 2,942-object corpus has hash verification, but rule denominators remain unknown. All 200 reference cases now have bounded source follow-ups (62 partially resolved, 138 unchanged); the 200 evaluation cases remain separately assessed and unfrozen. Two subsequent NPPA acquisitions failed; no new price original or claim amount was established.

reference_followup_derivation.scope: Generalized information additions are mapped through existing requirement groups; no source gap is resolved by adding a field.
